fields.name: radius
fields.notes: Radius of this planet's sphere. ContentParser default: 1.

fields.name: sectorSize
fields.notes: Sector grid size. 0 means no grid (cannot land).

fields.name: parent
fields.notes: Parent body that this planet orbits around. If null, this planet is a sun.

fields.name: orbitRadius
fields.notes: Orbital radius around the parent.

fields.name: orbitTime
fields.notes: Time for the planet to orbit around the sun once, in seconds.

fields.name: rotateTime
fields.notes: Time for a full rotation, in seconds.

fields.name: tidalLock
fields.notes: Whether this planet is tidally locked to its parent.

fields.name: accessible
fields.notes: Whether this planet is listed in the planet access UI.

fields.name: startSector
fields.notes: The default starting sector displayed.

fields.name: defaultCore
fields.notes: Default core block for launching.

fields.name: defaultEnv
fields.notes: Environment flags for sectors on this planet.

fields.name: defaultAttributes
fields.notes: Default environment attributes.

fields.name: updateLighting
fields.notes: Whether day/night cycle is simulated.

fields.name: lightSrcFrom
fields.notes: Day/night cycle - light source start.

fields.name: lightSrcTo
fields.notes: Day/night cycle - light source end.

fields.name: lightDstFrom
fields.notes: Day/night cycle - light destination start.

fields.name: lightDstTo
fields.notes: Day/night cycle - light destination end.

fields.name: bloom
fields.notes: Whether bloom render effect is enabled.

fields.name: visible
fields.notes: Whether this planet is displayed.

fields.name: hasAtmosphere
fields.notes: Whether this planet has an atmosphere.

fields.name: atmosphereRadIn
fields.notes: Atmosphere inner radius.

fields.name: atmosphereRadOut
fields.notes: Atmosphere outer radius.

fields.name: atmosphereColor
fields.notes: Atmosphere tint color.

fields.name: lightColor
fields.notes: Light color (for suns).

fields.name: iconColor
fields.notes: Icon color in planet list.

fields.name: icon
fields.notes: Icon name for the planet selection dialog.

fields.name: landCloudColor
fields.notes: Tint of clouds displayed when landing.

fields.name: mesh
fields.notes: Planet mesh (NoiseMesh, SunMesh, HexSkyMesh, or ShaderSphereMesh).

fields.name: cloudMesh
fields.notes: Cloud mesh overlay.

fields.name: minZoom
fields.notes: Minimum camera zoom.

fields.name: maxZoom
fields.notes: Maximum camera zoom.

fields.name: drawOrbit
fields.notes: Whether to draw the orbital circle.

fields.name: allowLaunchSchematics
fields.notes: Allow custom launch schematic.

fields.name: allowLaunchLoadout
fields.notes: Allow custom launch loadout.

fields.name: allowSectorInvasion
fields.notes: Simulate sector invasions from enemy bases.

fields.name: allowWaves
fields.notes: Whether waves are created on sector loss.

fields.name: allowLaunchToNumbered
fields.notes: Allow launching to numbered sectors.

fields.name: enemyBuildSpeedMultiplier
fields.notes: Enemy rebuild speed multiplier.

fields.name: enemyInfiniteItems
fields.notes: Enemy team has infinite items.

fields.name: prebuildBase
fields.notes: Build up blocks on landing.

fields.name: ruleSetter
fields.notes: Rules setup. Object that will be applied as sector rules.

fields.name: launchCapacityMultiplier
fields.notes: Core item capacity multiplier when launching.

fields.name: launchMusic
fields.notes: Music played in the planet dialog.

fields.name: unlockedOnLand
fields.notes: Content unlocked upon first landing.

fields.name: orbitSpacing
fields.notes: Orbital spacing between this planet and its children.

fields.name: camRadius
fields.notes: Camera radius offset. 0 means auto.

fields.name: clipRadius
fields.notes: Frustum sphere clip radius. -1 means auto.

fields.name: sectorSeed
fields.notes: Seed for sector generation. -1 uses random based on ID.

fields.name: allowCampaignRules
fields.notes: Allow players to change difficulty/rules in the planet UI.

fields.name: allowLegacyLaunchPads
fields.notes: If true, legacy launch pads can be enabled.

fields.name: clearSectorOnLose
fields.notes: If true, sector saves are cleared when lost.

fields.name: enemyFactoryActivationDelay
fields.notes: Default activation delay for enemy factories.

fields.name: enemyCoreSpawnReplace
fields.notes: If true, enemy cores are replaced with spawn points.

fields.name: alwaysPlayMusic
fields.notes: Overrides ambient music to always play.

fields.name: autoAssignPlanet
fields.notes: If true, tech tree content auto-assigns this planet.

fields.name: allowSelfSectorLaunch
fields.notes: Allow interplanetary accelerators to launch to 'any' sector on this planet.

fields.name: showRtsAIRule
fields.notes: If true, RTS AI rules can be customized.

fields.name: loadPlanetData
fields.notes: If true, planet data is loaded from 'planets/{name}.json'. Vanilla only!
